artworks.title: Soul of the Matriarch
artworks.medium: Compressed charcoal and graphite on Strathmore 400 paper
artworks.description: A deeply expressive hyper-realistic charcoal study of a Kikuyu elder matriarch. Crafted with fine graphite layering and intense velvety charcoal, capturing every wrinkle of wisdom and timeless grace.

artworks.title: Sovereign of the Savannah
artworks.medium: Carbon pencil and powdered charcoal on toned archival sheet
artworks.description: A powerful tribute to Kenya's wild royalty. The lion stands poised against a minimalist dark backdrop, with individual whiskers and deep, brooding gaze brought to life through intricate cross-hatching and erasure highlights.

artworks.title: Contemplation in Monochrome
artworks.medium: Vine charcoal and white chalk on Fabriano paper
artworks.description: An evocative chiaroscuro portrait exploring introspection and human stillness. The stark play of pure light against deep obsidian shadows creates a mesmerizing presence in any modern space.

artworks.title: Whispers of Kirinyaga
artworks.medium: Charcoal and conté crayon on textured cotton rag
artworks.description: Atmospheric charcoal landscape capturing the tea terraces and gentle mist rolling over the hills of Kutus, Kirinyaga. A piece rooted in the artist's homeland.

artworks.title: Mount Kenya at Dawn
artworks.medium: Impasto acrylic and oil on heavy stretched canvas
artworks.description: A majestic panoramic celebration of Batian and Nelion peaks illuminated by first dawn. Textured palette knife strokes layer brilliant vermilion, ochre, and icy cobalt against the morning sky.

artworks.title: Rhythms of Nairobi (Matatu Culture)
artworks.medium: Textured acrylic and spray enamel on gallery canvas
artworks.description: An explosion of urban kinetic energy. Custom graffiti-adorned matatus, wet asphalt reflecting neon shop lights, and the vibrant pulse of Nairobi city life.

artworks.title: Serengeti Horizon Symphony
artworks.description: A rich, luminous depiction of the golden hour on the East African plains. Glowing crimson and molten amber skies frame the silhouettes of wild acacia branches in perfect harmony.

artworks.title: Flora Euphoria
artworks.medium: Acrylic and 24K gold leaf on wood panel
artworks.description: An organic symphony of indigenous Kenyan blossoms accented with luminous metallic gold leaf that shifts dynamically under warm gallery lighting.

artworks.title: Shadow Assassin: Shinobi Genesis
artworks.medium: Digital fine-art illustration on metallic pearl canvas
artworks.description: Dynamic anime action concept. A rogue shadow shinobi mid-strike with electric cyan chakra trails, glowing crimson eye effect, and intricate cyberpunk garment detailing.

artworks.title: Celestial Sorceress of the Astral Gate
artworks.medium: Mixed digital illustration and acrylic varnish finish
artworks.description: Stunning ethereal anime character portrait featuring flowing silver hair woven with constellations, celestial sigils, and iridescent violet color grading.

artworks.title: Flame Breaker (Nichirin Blade)
artworks.medium: Ink lines and digital coloring on metallic archival print
artworks.description: High-octane tribute artwork showcasing a blazing katana technique. Vibrant swirling flame dragons rendered with traditional sumi-e brush textures fused with anime intensity.

artworks.title: Neo-Tokyo Midnight Phantom
artworks.medium: Digital painting on framed acrylic glass
artworks.description: Atmospheric cyberpunk anime illustration. A masked drifter seated atop a customized retro-futuristic bike overlooking a rain-soaked neon skyline.

inquiries.name: Wanjiku Mwangi
inquiries.subject: Inquiry on Soul of the Matriarch Original Piece
inquiries.message: Hello Ian, I was deeply moved by the detail in your charcoal piece "Soul of the Matriarch". Is it framed and ready to ship to Nairobi? Please let me know the delivery timeline.

inquiries.name: Brian Omondi
inquiries.subject: Commission and Mount Kenya painting inquiry
inquiries.message: Hi Ian! Love your landscape paintings. I am interested in "Mount Kenya at Dawn" for my new living room in Westlands. Also wondering if you do custom commission work on large canvas?

inquiries.name: Grace Wambui
inquiries.subject: Inquiry on Charcoal Original
inquiries.message: Hello Ian, I would like to reserve this piece for private delivery.
